tools.name: describe
tools.description: Read a Drawbridge/draw.io network diagram and return its contents as structured JSON: devices, links, pages, layers and groups — for auditing or querying an existing drawing. Results carry `name`: a suggested basename for this diagram. Write every file for one diagram into its own directory named af

tools.name: export
tools.description: Render a Drawbridge/draw.io network diagram to an output format (svg, png, drawio, dot, csv, netbox.csv, netbox-devices.csv, describe.json, clab.yml). Returns the exported content. CHOOSING `kind`: `drawio` when the user will open or edit the drawing (this is usually what they want, and it is the on

tools.name: create_diagram
tools.description: Generate a routed, laid-out network diagram from topology text (Graphviz DOT, Mermaid, CSV, CDP/LLDP neighbour output from most switch vendors, a FortiLink topology dump, Containerlab, Meraki or UniFi JSON, or an Ansible inventory — every format is listed in the drawbridge://guide resource) and expo

tools.name: edit_diagram
tools.description: CHANGE AN EXISTING DIAGRAM instead of regenerating it: add, update and remove devices and links in a .drawio document and get the edited document back. This is the tool for "add a switch to this drawing" — `create_diagram` would redraw the whole page and throw away every position a human placed by h

tools.name: validate
tools.description: CHECK TOPOLOGY TEXT BEFORE DRAWING IT: reads the same source `create_diagram` would and reports what it found — the format it detected, how many devices and links it would draw, and every line it would skip or adjust, with the line number and the reason. An unknown `kind=` names the nearest real one

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "create_diagram" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: export, create_diagram · Private data: describe, export, create_diagram, edit_diagram, validate · Public sink: describe, export, create_diagram, edit_diagram, validate · Destructive: export, create_diagram, edit_diagram, validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: export, create_diagram · Private data: describe, export, create_diagram, edit_diagram, validate · Public sink: describe, export, create_diagram, edit_diagram, validate · Destructive: export, create_diagram, edit_diagram, validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
